title: Report: Signing with Washington "intriguing" to Stefon Diggs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Signing with Washington "intriguing" to Stefon Diggs
sources.description: A recent report indicated five teams have been keeping tabs on free agent wide receiver Stefon Diggs heading into free agency and there's now word of a team that has caught Diggs's eye.
